Definition: of Chaldee or (H7662 with pronominal suffix); thou hast left me; sabachthani (i.e. shebakthani), a cry of distress:--sabachthani.
BiblicalUsage: Sabachtháni names thou hast left me; sabachthani (that is shebakthani), a cry of distress. It stands in Mark 15:34, "…loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which…", and in Matthew 27:46, "…a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani?…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sabachtháni is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
